scope: Current standalone chapter question bank; source-level semantic review with per-question traceability, not CBSE approval.

IT.title: CBSE Information Technology (402), Class X, 2026–27
IT.used: 17 pages read; chapter tables on pages 4–13, unit allocation on page 3.

ES.title: CBSE Employability Skills, Class X, 2026–27
ES.used: All 3 pages read; detailed outcomes for all five Part A units.

A1-methods.title: Methods of communication
A1-methods.scope: Verbal, non-verbal and visual communication; advantages, limitations and suitable body language.

A1-feedback.title: Communication cycle and feedback
A1-feedback.scope: Communication cycle; meaning and importance of feedback; descriptive, specific and non-specific feedback.

A1-barriers.title: Communication barriers and remedies
A1-barriers.scope: Types and factors of barriers; applying measures to overcome barriers, including clarification and listening.

A1-principles.title: Principles and 7 Cs
A1-principles.scope: Effective communication and the 7 Cs; conveying required facts and showing respect.

A1-writing.title: Basic writing skills
A1-writing.scope: Sentence and phrase; kinds and parts of sentences; parts of speech; articles and paragraph construction.

A2-stress.title: Stress management
A2-stress.scope: Meaning and importance of stress management; physical exercise, yoga, meditation, holidays, supportive leisure and nature walks.

A2-independent.title: Independent work and self-management
A2-independent.scope: Self-awareness, self-motivation, self-regulation; planning goals and activities and executing tasks in a specified period.

A3-files.title: Operating systems and file management
A3-files.scope: Classes of operating systems; desktop menus, icons and taskbar; file operations, directories, creating and managing files and folders and restoring from the Recycle Bin.

A3-care.title: Computer care and maintenance
A3-care.scope: Hardware/software care, cleaning and maintenance schedules; virus protection and scanning; removal of SPAM and temporary material (continued on page 3). Backup and safe handling appear as practical care precautions, not advanced security theory.

A4-enterprise.title: Entrepreneurship and society
A4-enterprise.scope: Qualities, functions, role and importance of an entrepreneur; myths and career choices; local success stories, strengths/weaknesses, collecting business information and team business planning.

A5-sustainability.title: Sustainable development
A5-sustainability.scope: Definition, importance, problems and solutions; environmental citizenship, indigenous knowledge, cultural heritage and models of rainwater harvesting, irrigation and solar energy.

B1.title: Writer styles
B1.scope: Style categories (page, paragraph, character, frame, list and table); Styles and Formatting; Fill Format; creation from selection or drag-and-drop; updating, loading and applying styles.

B2.title: Images and drawing objects
B2.scope: Insertion by command, drag/drop, copy/paste or linking; modification, resizing, cropping and deletion; drawing object properties, grouping, arrangement, anchoring, alignment and text wrapping.

B3.title: Advanced Writer features
B3.scope: Heading hierarchy and creating/customising/updating/deleting a ToC; creating, importing, editing, moving, exporting and applying templates; recorded changes, accept/reject, comments and document comparison (continued on page 6).

B4.title: Spreadsheet analysis
B4.scope: Consolidation, groups and subtotals, what-if scenarios and analysis, Goal Seek and Solver in the practical outcomes (continued on page 7).

B5.title: Spreadsheet macros
B5.scope: Recording, running, creating and organising simple macros; macro functions and arguments, passing values, direct cell access and sorting columns using a macro.

B6.title: Linking spreadsheet data
B6.scope: Setting up multiple sheets; references to other sheets and documents using keyboard/mouse; relative and absolute hyperlinks; creating/editing/removing hyperlinks; external and registered data sources (continued on page 8).

B7.title: Spreadsheet sharing and review
B7.scope: Sharing, opening and saving shared work; recording changes; adding/editing/formatting comments; viewing/accepting/rejecting changes; merging and comparing.

B8.title: DBMS foundations
B8.scope: Data versus information; databases and advantages; hierarchical, network and relational models; fields, records, tables, keys and RDBMS objects.

B9.title: Starting with Base and tables
B9.scope: Base interface, opening databases and data types; Table Wizard and Design View; primary keys, saving, entering, navigating, editing, deleting and sorting records (continued on page 10).

B10.title: Multiple tables and relationships
B10.scope: Editing/deleting tables and records; one-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-many relationships; advantages and creation/editing of relationships, field properties and referential integrity.

B11.title: Queries in Base
B11.scope: Query creation with Wizard and Design View; editing; single/multiple-field criteria and wildcards; working with numerical data and calculations in queries (continued on page 11). No requirement here for standalone advanced SQL syntax drills.

B12.title: Forms and reports
B12.scope: Form Wizard, entering/removing/searching records through forms; modifying labels/backgrounds and controls; Report Wizard, examples, additional controls, titles/headings and date/time.

B13.title: Health, safety and security
B13.scope: Policies, reasons for safety programmes, physical/fall/electrical/fire/health hazards; computer/office-equipment/object handling; stress, environment, hazard control and checklists (continued on page 12).

B14.title: Workplace quality
B14.scope: Air/water monitoring and cleanliness; ergonomics; computer health and safety; musculoskeletal and visual problems, headaches, obesity, stress, laptop injuries and sleeping problems; workplace cautions.

B15.title: Accidents and emergencies
B15.scope: Identify incidents, get suitable help, follow company rules and authority limits; follow senior/emergency instructions; accident types, reporting, evacuation, fire prevention and electrical/first-aid response (continued on page 13).

A5-greenwork.title: Green economy and green jobs
A5-greenwork.scope: The IT-402 Class X course learning outcomes explicitly include the green economy, green jobs, sustainable practices, environmental conservation and eco-friendly initiatives.
